name: golf-stars
description: A travelling space golf RPG — voyage the galaxy playing procedurally-generated golf courses.

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && VITE_HUB=1 vite build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
